definitions.explanation: Extremely large in amount, scale, or extent.

examples.japanese: {莫大|ばくだい}な{費用|ひよう}がかかった。
examples.english: It cost an enormous amount of money.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{莫大|ばくだい}な{財産|ざいさん}を{相続|そうぞく}した。
{莫大|ばくだい}な{借金|しゃっきん}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: They are burdened with an enormous debt.

notes:
Used to describe extremely large amounts, especially of money, resources, or abstract quantities.

FORMS:
・{莫大|ばくだい}な + noun
・{莫大|ばくだい}に + verb (rarely used)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{莫大|ばくだい}な{費用|ひよう} (enormous cost)
・{莫大|ばくだい}な{財産|ざいさん} (vast fortune)
・{莫大|ばくだい}な{借金|しゃっきん} (huge debt)
・{莫大|ばくだい}な{利益|りえき} (enormous profit)
・{莫大|ばくだい}な{損害|そんがい} (tremendous damage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{膨大|ぼうだい} - immense (often for volume or data)
・{巨大|きょだい} - huge (physical size)
・{莫大|ばくだい} - enormous (typically for amounts, money)
